act_1.title: The Quad Crisis and the 14ms Wire Rescue

beats.speaker: Akshay
beats.line: My water bottle leaked in my bag! The ink is completely dissolved!

beats.speaker: Akshay
beats.line: Twelve thousand students are hitting the portal at once. It just timed out!

beats.speaker: Rohan
beats.line: Twenty minutes until gates lock, Akshay! The portal is down for everyone!

beats.speaker: Akshay
beats.line: Spinning circle of doom... Why won't the browser render my roll number?!

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: Breathe, Akshay. The browser is choking on images and CSS, not your data.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: Here is your JSON admit card from the wire. Fourteen milliseconds flat.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: Chai first. An engineer who panics sees magic; an engineer who understands sees wires.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: You are the customer sitting at the table. You want butter naan, but you cannot enter the kitchen.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: The waiter is the API. He takes your exact order on a notepad and carries it safely past the swinging kitchen doors.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: The browser is a heavy four megabyte bullock cart. An API call is a pure hundred byte courier on horseback.

act_3.title: Building Port 3000 and the Undefined Body Crash

beats.speaker: Akshay
beats.line: TypeError! req.body is undefined! I sent valid JSON in my cURL command!

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: Look at the physical Ethernet wire, Akshay. What travels across copper?

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: TCP does not know JSON. It streams fragmented raw bytes across the wire. Without a parser, it slips through your fingers.

beats.speaker: Akshay
beats.line: Adding app.use(express.json())... It reassembles the byte stream into an object!

beats.speaker: Akshay
beats.line: Status 201 Created! The student record is stored in memory!

act_4.title: The Brass Thali Feast and CRUD Operations

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: Every interaction with a server maps to dining rules. Let us decode the five core verbs.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: GET is reading the menu or inspecting the thali. Safe and idempotent. Looking changes nothing.

beats.speaker: Akshay
beats.line: POST is bringing a brand new thali to the table. Each call creates a new resource!

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: The Brass Thali Trap! PUT replaces the entire platter! If you omit the katori, it vanishes!

beats.speaker: Akshay
beats.line: PATCH is surgical. A spoonful of hot dal toppings without replacing the platter.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: Status codes are server weather reports: 2xx green garden, 4xx locked wicket, 5xx kitchen fire.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: Three philosophies shape modern distributed systems. REST, SOAP, and GraphQL.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: REST is a standard open postcard. Clear address, standard stamps, readable by any courier.

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: SOAP is an armored bank vault with wax seals and heavy XML contracts. Rigid, heavy, enterprise safe.

beats.speaker: Akshay
beats.line: GraphQL is a spice market basket! The client asks for cardamom and clove, and gets only that!

beats.speaker: Sameer
beats.line: To the wire, Akshay. Today you saw through the glass. Tomorrow, we test it to destruction.
